title: Novel fabrication of biodegradable superabsorbent polymer from wheat stalk for water holding and sustained fertilizer release
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,9420-9429
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00143A, Paper

Yang Chenxi, Wang Jian, Wang Yingguo, Zhang Haiou, He Puchun
The WS/PAA–PAM is capable of loading water and fertilizers. During the slow release of water and fertilizers, WS can gradual degradation under the combined effects of moisture, temperature, and fungi, ultimately breaking down completely in the soil.
